moshi_turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?
Try the noughts and crosses game. Imagine that grid over the picture and put the interesting thing where two lines cross, not right in the middle.
You can even turn the grid on in the camera settings, so he sees it on screen.
Give him little missions. Find something red, take a photo from as low as a mouse, take one from on top of a chair.
Quite possibly. But he'll learn more from that than from any rule. Look through his photos together after and ask which one he likes most and why.
